lhs: Legal positive-stride rank-one slice of an ordered concatenation with a singleton result.
rhs: Return the selected compatible singleton operand or slice the first operand whose prefix endpoint strictly exceeds the original start, retaining the stride and using a unit local window.
conditions: Rank-one static arrays; nonnegative representable prefix and index arithmetic, positive stride, legal half-open limit, computed output extent exactly one. Direct reuse requires compatibility and hence a logical singleton; the fallback also covers singleton operands.
types: Lists over any element type; equality of the full rank-one output including length.
overlap: Prior HandleSlice concat scan/crop results model unit stride and both endpoint searches. A scalar-output window at larger stride may cross multiple operands. These two helper branches and their delegating caller form one mathematical case.
